method: Independent derivation and numeric verification, separate from rendered appearance
derivation: An ideal linear polarizer is the projection uuᵀ. Starting after the first vertical polarizer with unit intensity, the two subsequent projections give Eout=(sinθ cosθ,0) and Iout=sin²θ cos²θ=¼sin²2θ. The maximum is ¼ at θ=45°; each stage then halves intensity.
limitations: No absolute input intensity before the first polarizer is specified.
Ideal filters; brightness impressions are not a calibrated optical measurement.
